::: {.lead-note}

I am a civil servant in the Provincial Government of North Sulawesi and have
held procurement roles across the full cycle of public buying — from procurement
official and commitment-making official to member of provincial selection
working groups. That institutional experience is the origin of both my
professional practice and my research interest in how public resources are
actually allocated.

:::
